## Description

A large, rigid hypotrich (~300 µm when starved) that walks and jumps on the glass with its cirri and
eats algae, flagellates and diatoms with a peristome half its length. Dorsoventrally flattened, with
almost parallel sides and rounded ends.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 3 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.

estimated).
